name: @kubeverse/desktop
description: KubeVerse desktop shell (Electron): owns the local backend process lifecycle and loads the KubeVerse UI. CommonJS deliberately, not ESM like the rest of the monorepo: Electron's own built-in `electron` module (app, BrowserWindow, ...) is a native binding that Electron's module loader only swaps in for require() - importing it under Node's own ESM loader resolves to the plain npm package instead (which only exports the path to the electron binary, for spawning it externally) and leaves app/BrowserWindow undefined. CommonJS is also what Electron's own official quickstart template uses for exactly this reason.
author: KubeVerse
